The decisive mistake was the Orchestrator's at Step 9. It declared the current C-suite "obtained" from a partial list. WebSurfer's Step 8 screenshot showed only four profiles (Roy Mann, Eran Zinman, Eliran Glazer, Shiran Nawi) in a 31% viewport, and nobody scrolled to check for more. Yoni Osherov and Daniel Lereya, two of the correct answers, were therefore never considered. The later "verified" fact list at Step 46 carried this incomplete roster forward.

The historical IPO-era roster was also never found, so the Step 46 guess that Eliran Glazer might be a post-IPO addition went unverified and ended up in the final answer. That guess compounded the error, but the incomplete current list was the root problem.
